scope: Test-oracle coverage only; no observed product failure, no reproduction or runtime action.

finding.count_query: Counts confirmed allocations across all allocation_coin rows for each original source, without requiring c.active.
finding.confirmation_query: Checks Core6 for DISTINCT active confirmed parents, but does not require that result covers both original sources or is nonempty.
finding.conditional_false_positive: If ledger inconsistency leaves exactly one inactive confirmed historical allocation per source and no active confirmed allocation, the first query can set ready=true while the Core6 loop runs zero times. This review does not establish that the product can create that state.
finding.additional_missing_money_oracles: Final canonical set is not independently rechecked for exact net payout/per-actual-output fee, zero parent fee, every original source grant dependency or absence of the recipient fallback output, unlike the pre-fork set.
finding.recommended_evidence: Require complete exact active canonical coverage of both original source IDs, then check actual current canonical parent inputs/outputs and source-specific grant bindings. Permit the declared valid C9 grouping rather than forcing an old physical allocation. Independent retained-chain reconciliation can close factual money evidence for an observed run, without converting the source test into full general coverage.
finding.does_not_authorize: No test weakening, deadline extension, SQL financial state injection, native rerun, source mutation or historical failure reclassification.

mutations: Only this external source-review addendum; frozen source/publication/counters unchanged.
